channel.title: Jihoon Kim — AI/ML Engineer Consultant
channel.description: AI/ML Engineer Consultant. Field notes on AWS, generative AI, and putting agents into production.

item.title: I Implemented the Protocol Behind AgentCore Payments, Here's What the Managed Service Hides
item.description: AWS previewed AgentCore Payments in May 2026, letting agents pay autonomously. I rebuilt the underlying x402 flow from scratch, real signatures, a budget guard, and a runaway-spend experiment, to see what 'connect a wallet' actually commits you to.

item.title: A Commerce Agent Governance Framework, Backed by Measurements, Not Bullet Points
item.description: Six governance domains to check before you let an agent pay autonomously. Each claim is backed by numbers from a runaway-spend experiment I built on a from-scratch x402 implementation.
